title: Gentle closeness holds different speeds
meaning: Your attention can remain mutual amid tension when a fitting measure does not require an intense response to be suppressed.
text: Not every strong feeling needs an immediate answer of equal force. In the physical position of Anahata, the Lovers express care through freely offered attention and closeness. Temperance in energy brings a wish to combine different needs and find a fitting measure of involvement. Strength in emotions offers consideration before an intense response. Tenderness can hold irritation or uncertainty without becoming a demand for calm. Both people keep feelings of their own that need room too.

For example, you are dismantling something fragile that needs transporting. One person hurries and becomes irritated by a delay; the other suggests a pause and another way of helping. **A fitting measure can keep care present within an intense response.** You can name frustration and share one small action without extending the argument through every movement. Support is recognised through a willing wish to remain beside the person. An awkward tone need not be called acceptable to prove tenderness or preserve a peaceful appearance.

Accord loses honesty when both people concede silently before being heard. The object is packed and everything looks calm, but something remains unspoken for each. Gentleness avoids an actual encounter. Closeness benefits from returning to a feeling without another surge. Consideration does not require forgetting what hurt; it allows words that still leave room for two within the conversation.
